page.layout: One printed page. Running head "EMBLEMA" at top centre, above a heading "MEVM: TVVM: SVVM." Page number top left. A woodcut illustration fills the centre (town street with merchants and barrels, and a row of figures bargaining below). Below the woodcut, a four-line verse set in italic, centred. A catchword-like word "Inter" sits at the lower right, outside the text block.

main_text.l: Iusta licent in præsenti commercia seclo,
Sistere non alias ciuica vita potest:
Verum absint fraudesq; doliq;, & crimina falsi,
Sistere non alias ciuica vita potest.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a town street with barrels and bales, and below it a market scene with figures seated and bargaining. The word "Inter" at lower right may be a catchword, placed outside the text block. The verse line "Iusta licent in præsenti commercia seclo," is set with a word-space irregularity after "licent" and "in". The line "Verum absint fraudesq; doliq;, & crimina falsi," ends with "falsi," as printed. The word "Inter" is treated as a catchword in the lower margin; it may instead be a marginal fragment.
